sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Kay Premium Marking Films has been manufacturing premium quality self-adhesive vinyl films at their plant in South Wales, UK since 1991.

Industry: Manufacturing · HQ: South Wales, United Kingdom · Size: <$50M · Products: Cast Vehicle Wrap, Calendered Signage, Paint Protection Film, Speciality Cast Vinyl, Overlaminate Vinyl Films, Functional Films

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Kay Premium Marking Films scores 78 of 100 (tier A) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (30/30), application fit (24/25) and event engagement (15/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (69% similar on films, vinyl, vehicle, wrap); Mactac (56% similar on films, vinyl, signage, vehicle); ORAFOL Europe (40% similar on films, self-adhesive, graphics, orafol). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
